India Records $94.53 Billion FDI in FY 2025-26

India recorded Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) inflows of $94.53 billion in the fiscal year 2025-26, a figure described as a record. The cumulative FDI from 2014 to 2026 reached $843 billion. The government's Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme was cited as a factor boosting exports and jobs.
